_readme: Cross-check anchors for `npm run verify`. Fill these numbers from your PREVIOUS flight-log system's statistics page (screenshot it before it disappears), then copy this file to migration/anchors.json. verify compares your imported DB against these anchors and reports PASS/FAIL per item. Only rows with a migration number (fm_no) are checked, so the app stays verifiable after you keep adding flights. All values below are FAKE placeholders — replace every one of them with your own.
_notes: scope = domestic/intra-continental/inter-continental counts by comparing departure vs arrival country/continent (see server/lib/geo.ts classifyFlight). Top lists: order does not matter, only the per-entry counts and the sorted count sequence are compared; include as many entries as your old system showed. classes/seatPos: 'none' = flights with the field empty.
